articleTitle: Deep Learning for Alzheimer's Disease Classification: CNN Model Using MRI Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Early discovery of Alzheimer's disease is important for efficient intervention and management since it is a degenerative brain illness that seriously affects cognitive abilities. This work directs to build a CNN model to categorise several phases of Alzheimer's disease depending on MRI data. Drawn from the open-source Kaggle platform, the dataset consists of 6,400 MRI scans separated into four classes. The images were homogeneous pre-processed CNN model training and validation then followed from this. The algorithm showed to be really good in spotting Alzheimer's phases in class with an incredible 99% accuracy. Showing great accuracy, recall, and F1-scores across all categories, the classification report presents a well-balanced and well- performing model. Furthermore, showing low misclassifications in the confusion matrix emphasises the model's capacity to span the several phases of Alzheimer's. The findings show CNN's promise in automated Alzheimer's detection, providing a consistent, non-invasive instrument for early diagnosis and so improving patient care and treatment planning.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Routing Protocols: Enhancing Energy Efficiency and Security in Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper aims to provide a systematic and critical analysis of current routing protocols in wireless networks with regard to energy saving and security features improvements. A few protocols like the Reliable Energy-Efficient Opportunistic Routing (REOR) and Secure Link State Routing (SLSR) are explained as to how they help in increasing the lifespan of energy and successfully counter security threats. These protocols implement path-diversity, dynamic-forwarder selection, and path-randomization mechanisms to enhance both reliability and security. The simulation findings show a high level of energy saving, packet delivery rates, and reduced vulnerability to eavesdropping. We also discuss some potential mixtures of energy efficiency and security strategies.

articleTitle: The Possibilities of Introduction of Augmented Reality Technologies as a New Impetus for the Development of Post-Pandemic Tourism in Uzbekistan
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper examines the prospects of integrating augmented reality (AR) technologies into the development of tourism in Uzbekistan, where a rich literary heritage is preserved. The main emphasis is placed on the development of a mobile application based on augmented reality technology and Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) algorithm, which allows users in an interactive format to explore the houses-museums of famous writers with accurate positioning and visualization of virtual content in a real environment. The SLAM algorithm provides simultaneous map generation and user localization, allowing the mobile device to accurately determine the user's position in space and adapt AR content based on the user's position and orientation. This approach allows achieving high accuracy when superimposing virtual objects on real elements, which is especially important for museums.

Author Keywords: Spatial and marker-based augmented reality technologies

articleTitle: Use of Synergetic Synthesis Method to Improve the Quality of Steam Generator Control at Thermal Power Facilities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper proposes a method of applying the method of synergetic synthesis to improve the quality of control of steam generators in thermal power systems. The disadvantages of traditional linear control methods, which do not take into account nonlinear interactions and introduce properties of modern steam generators, are discussed. The authors note the need to develop microprocessor-based automated control systems to improve the reliability and efficiency of thermal systems under peak conditions and emergency situations. The proposed control methods include two-channel coordinated control, which allows simultaneous control of turbine mechanical power and synchronous generator excitation. Simulation results using MATLAB/ Simulink show that the synergistic control methods provide higher stability, smaller fluctuations and adaptation to instability compared to conservative methods.

Author Keywords: Method of analytical design of aggregated controllers

articleTitle: An Optimized Pathfinding in a 2D Zombie Survival Game Using the Jump Point Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Pathfinding is important for many games that use non-playable characters to reach targets in a 2D or 3D environment. In this paper, uses Jump Point Search (JPS) algorithm for path finding in a 2D Zombie Survival Game. JPS is an optimal, heuristic-based algorithm for finding the shortest route in a grid-based game environment. It skips unnecessary nodes to reach the goal state quickly. In this paper, we use three different heuristic functions, namely Euclidean, Manhattan, and Chebyshev distances, to analyze the efficiency (execution time or speed) of the JPS algorithm. From experimental analysis, JPS with the Chebyshev distance heuristic provides faster movement towards the target, taking an average of 6.45 seconds to reach the target, which is faster compared to the other heuristics.

articleTitle: Computational Approaches for Solving Complex Differential Equations: Implementation of the Direct Numerical Method with Modeling and Analysis of Bifurcation Diagrams and Lyapunov Exponent
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In different areas like physics, engineering, biology, for example, to predict the behavior of composite systems one has to solve complex differential equations. This paper reviews the direct numerical method as a computational technique used to solve the difficult Equations above. Therefore, the application of this method will help us identify the behavior of large systems. Some of the methods used in the analysis include; creation of bifurcation diagrams to analyze how the system responds to different parameters, examine of Lyapunov exponent in an effort to understand the initial conditions' sensitiveness. Thus, in this paper uses the mentioned techniques to provide a clear understanding of the naturel of interactions within such systems. In addition to evidencing the value of direct numerical methods for rendering a precise portrayal of the systems, this study also improves our general comprehension of the underlying theory of such systems.

articleTitle: A BiLSTM-Based Sentiment Analysis Scheme for Khmer NLP in Time-Series Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This research studies the extraction of sentiments from the Khmer language through machine learning and deep learning methods, specifically the Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) network. To achieve this, it employs a quantitative approach to analyze the result from the different training classifiers, including Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naïve Bayes (NB), Random Forest (RF), K-Nearest Neighbors (K-NN), and the BiLSTM neural network. The study also utilized a pre-trained BERT model on the Khmer language as the embedding model combined with applying preprocessing techniques, such as data cleaning and word segmentation before the classifications. The performance of the models is evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The findings reveal that BiLSTM with the contextual embeddings from BERT, achieves the greatest performance resulting in an accuracy rate of 86%, outperforming the traditional machine learning algorithms in classifying Khmer text sentiments into negative, neutral, and positive classes.

articleTitle: Global Maternal Mortality Rate: A Cluster-Based Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Health of the citizens plays a critical role in the growth of the nation in all aspects. Government healthcare expenditure constitutes a substantial portion of the gross domestic product (GDP). A healthy mother who delivers a healthy baby contributes significantly to the nation's future. Governments worldwide have implemented numerous initiatives to support individuals with physical and mental disabilities, premature infants, and other vulnerable groups. As per the World Health Organization (WHO) report- 2020, nearly 285,000 women lost their lives during childbirth. Notably, more than 90% of these maternal loss happened in lower and lower-middle countries based on income, and the majority were preventable. The global Maternal Mortality Ratio-MMR is the number of maternal death toll per 100,000 live deliveries which is reduced by about 34% from 2000 to 2020. This study utilizes MMR data from the World Bank and WHO, covering the period from 2000 to 2020, to perform a comprehensive analysis. The unsupervised clustering algorithms are applied to form countries according to their MMR rate, with analysis performed using appropriate metrics. The evaluation categorizes countries based on their MMR above and below the global average, providing valuable inference for decision makers to initiate new policies to mitigate MMR in high-risk areas.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence of Things and a Review of Algorithmic Solutions Used in Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In recent years, the concept of Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) has gained significant attention due to the development of neural networks and deep learning technologies. The paper focuses on the advantages and applications of AIoT technology in various fields, application of AIoT technology in unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to increase their autonomy. It also examines architectures, frameworks, and various control systems with recognition of both single and clusters of UAVs. A trajectory for future research and a concept for the development of unmanned aerial vehicles with artificial intelligence for implementation in the agricultural industry are formulated.

articleTitle: Use of Information Technologies in the Digitalisation of the Logistics Sector in Uzbekistan
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the dynamic landscape of the expanding digital logistics sector, this study aims to delve into the intricacies of contemporary wireless Radio Frequency Identification technology. The primary focus is on unraveling the multifaceted capabilities and functions that Radio Frequency Identification technology brings to the forefront of modern logistics. Notably, this exploration is conducted within the unique context of the emerging logistical ecosystem in the New Uzbekistan, where the integration of cutting-edge technologies is pivotal for fostering efficiency and innovation. The investigation extends beyond a mere examination of Radio Frequency Identification technology's technical attributes, delving into the specific circumstances and regulatory frameworks that have been strategically implemented in the New Uzbekistan to facilitate the seamless adoption of Radio Frequency Identification technology. Understanding the contextual nuances is essential for grasping the symbiotic relationship between technological advancements and the regulatory environment in shaping the logistics landscape. Moreover, a comprehensive analysis is conducted to discern the surging demand for Radio Frequency Identification technology in contemporary logistics practices. The study seeks to identify the driving forces behind this increased adoption, shedding light on the transformative impact Radio Frequency Identification has on streamlining supply chains, enhancing inventory management, and optimizing overall logistics operations. By examining the specific use cases and applications, the research aims to provide actionable insights for stakeholders seeking to harness the potential of Radio Frequency Identification in the New Uzbekistan's evolving loaistlcal framework.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Performance of e-Government in Uzbekistan
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article analyzes the sub-indicators of the Electronic Government Development Index (EGDI), which assesses the development of electronic government in Uzbekistan, and proposes a methodology for developing the electronic government system in the republic. The work also conducted research to assess the quality of electronic services and suggested directions for further research.

articleTitle: The Impact of Digitalization on Psychological Treatment: Exploring Emerging Technologies in Mental Health Care
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The emerging rise in the availability of different technologies and digitalization has led to the evolution of psychology and its treatment. The study through this paper aims to provide a thorough discussion and conclusion development in the respective field to date and the variety of uses of digital mediation. The analysis and impact of various digital practices for mental illness treatment like Virtual Reality (VR), Video or Mobile Games, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Teletherapy, Telepsychiatry, and other possible mechanics and services are discussed that are the global circulation of psychological therapeutics. The paper aspires to push the importance of digital treatments, their needs, assessments, and training corroborated with current statistics.

articleTitle: Improving the Efficiency of Video Compression by a Bidirectional Resize of TV Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The possibility of increasing the compression efficiency of television (TV) images in industrial television systems, using various scaling transformations, which first divide the images by 2 horizontally and vertically before video compression is evaluated at the article. And then, after decoding, the original image sizes are restored. This approach allows to reduce the amount of video data by 4 before video compression and, accordingly, to increase the compression ratio of the video. The results of an experiment to see how efficiency increases for video compression and how much image distortion is introduced in the Dirac wavelet video codec using a bidirectional scaler are shown.

articleTitle: Comparative Performance of Supervised Learning Models for Software Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Predicting software defects is essential for enhancing software quality by identifying faulty components early in the development lifecycle. This research explores the effectiveness of different supervised learning algorithms in predicting defects using two well-known datasets, JM1 and KC2. The study examines the performance of five machine learning models: Logistic Regression, Gaussian Naive Bayes (GNB), K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN), Quadratic Discriminant Analysis (QDA), and Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA). These models are assessed using important metrics like as precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy for both defect-prone and non-defect-prone categories. Results indicate that KNN surpasses the other algorithms on both datasets, achieving the highest F1-scores for defect-prone instances, with values of 0.94 for JM1 and 0.65 for KC2. Conversely, Gaussian Naive Bayes and Quadratic Discriminant Analysis show lower performance, particularly due to reduced precision and recall in detecting defects. These outcomes underscore the difficulties caused by class imbalance in defect prediction and highlight the need for careful model selection to achieve the best results. This study provides insightful information on the strengths and weaknesses of popular classifiers used in defect prediction., providing useful recommendations for both researchers and industry professionals striving to improve defect detection systems.

articleTitle: Smart City Network Traffic Management Based on SDN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The paper considers the data traffic processing system in a segmented mobile network in smart cities. Smart cities have a number of services and applications with different quality of service (QoS) requirements. The paper focuses on solving the latency problem, which is a key performance indicator in terms of QoS, in time-sensitive applications in smart cities. Therefore, when considering a certain smart system, it is worth considering a set of traffic from VoIP to M2M devices. Using the Anylogic simulation program, the paper presents the process of data traffic processing in the uplink. In this case, all traffic is divided into three segmentation levels by QoS: sensitive, less sensitive and low sensitivity. For smart city networks, an important condition for implementation is to achieve minimal latency and maximum data transfer rate within the QoS.

articleTitle: Enhanced Flower Classification Using Convolutional Neural Networks: A Comparative Study of Bellflower, Common Daisy, Rose, and Sunflower Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Flower classification is vital in many disciplines, including botany, agriculture, environmental studies, and industry. Dependent traditionally on professional knowledge, improvements in digital image processing and machine learning techniques have changed this activity. This paper investigates the use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for four classifications bellflower, common daisy, rose, and sunflower—of flower images. Based on a Kaggle dataset, the work employs a CNN model with an astonishing 92% general accuracy. Stressing amazing accuracy and recall for roses and sunflowers, precision, recall, F1-score, and confusion matrix analysis serves to assess the performance of the model. Although the model excels in many aspects, it might need additional improvement to differentiate common daisies. The results show how successfully CNNs automate floral classification, therefore helping botanical study, commercial floriculture, agricultural management, and floral design. This work provides a good foundation for the next research aiming to increase model accuracy for less represented classes and investigate new techniques to address difficult classification challenges.

articleTitle: Organization of Word Search in Uzbek Language Texts
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The development of modern information and communication technologies has led to an increase in the need for means that express, store, edit, transmit and transform information in the form of text. This article analyzes the methods and algorithms used in the implementation of electronic word processing. Also, the application and features of the Boyer-Moore-Horspool algorithm were studied when searching for a given word in Uzbek texts. On the basis of the experiments, the relevant information and conclusions were obtained on evaluating the effectiveness of the algorithm. Computer linguistic methods and software libraries of preliminary processing of texts, dividing of words into syllables and their sound expression based on the rules of the Uzbek literary language were created.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-based Price Prediction and Analysis of Laptop Specifications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper explores the relationship between various laptop specifications and their prices using machine learning models. The dataset, obtained from Kaggle, includes attributes such as brand, screen size, operating system, RAM, and storage type. We apply data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis, and machine learning techniques to predict laptop prices in euros. The results show that specifications like storage type, RAM, and screen resolution have significant impacts on price prediction accuracy, achieving a high prediction accuracy of 91.8% using advanced models.

articleTitle: Automated System for Visualization and Optimization of Color Parameters of Fractal Images Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article addresses the problem of optimizing the color parameters of fractal images in design. It explores how artificial intelligence enhances fractal generation and proposes an automated control system integrating a genetic algorithm, simplex optimization method, and AI. The study aims to optimize fractal image color parameters, considering design features, using modern tools and integrated approaches

articleTitle: Automating Rice Crop Disease Classification with VGG16 and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Rice is a basic crop for almost half of the world's population, various diseases like Bacterial Blight, Blast, Brown Spot, and False Smut impair its output. Early, correct detection of these illnesses guarantees both effective management and lowest possible crop losses. The study proposes a fine-tuned VGG16 deep learning model strategy for rice crop diseases classification. It consists of 200 high quality images encompassing the four disease categories. Adding custom layers to focus on the specific job of disease classification and freezing the first layers helped the model to transformed for the fine-tuned vgg16 model. The fine-tuned VGG16 model attained an accuracy of 94%. Performance metrics including precision, recall, and F1-score showed outstanding results especially for Brown Spot and False Smut infections. The study provides a strong tool for early disease detection, thereby enabling sustainable management of rice fields and maybe higher agricultural yield.

articleTitle: Current State of Integration and Interoperability of Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The recent development of information systems (IS) in various industries has increased the demand for their integration and data interaction. Particular attention should be paid to the aspects of integration and compatibility to ensure stable operation of IS. This article provides an overview of IS integration and interoperability. 12,543 articles were analyzed, of which 21 were recognized as relevant. The study identifies modern integration and interaction methods and points out the need to develop specialized approaches to improve the efficiency and reliability of IS in the context of the growing complexity of modern systems.

articleTitle: Hand Gesture Detection Using VGG-16
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This work, focusing on the VGG16 architecture, developed a CNN model for hand motion detection. Methods of data augmentation to enhance resilience were incorporated by a library of photographs of hand gestures as training for the model. The batch size used in training the Adam optimizer was thirty-two. After ten ten-epoch training, the model for validation arrived with about ninety-six percent accuracy. Two dropout layers at 0.4 rate and batch normalization layers to prevent overfitting constituted the model; categorical cross-entropy was used for calculating the loss. The learning rate was in the normal level even if it's at maximum speed if the input picture size is 224x224 pixels. The findings are such that the algorithm detects many hand motions exactly in the same manner.

articleTitle: Yolo Landslide Sentry: A Framework for Rapid Detection and Response
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Landslides in hairpin bend regions pose unique challenges, demanding innovative solutions for effective detection and suppression. This paper introduces a new approach employing the YOLO object detection framework to address this issue. High-resolution satellite imagery is utilized to create detailed terrain models, enabling the identification of potential landslide triggers such as slope instability and changes in vegetation cover. YOLO's real-time capabilities facilitate early detection within these complex landscapes. Furthermore, ground-based sensors and weather stations provide continuous monitoring of environmental conditions, seamlessly integrated with the YOLO-based detection model. Community engagement is emphasized, involving local residents in evacuation plans and preparedness strategies. This interdisciplinary approach offers a comprehensive solution for proactively managing landslide risks in hairpin bend regions, enhancing disaster resilience and safeguarding vulnerable communities. The proposed model provides an F1 score of 0.89 with classification outcome of range of hazard levels.

articleTitle: Using Radio Frequency Identification Technology to Monitor Vehicle Speeds
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, discusses the development and research of a new vehicle speed control system using modern radio frequency identification technology. Practical solutions have been developed to control the speed of vehicles using built-in system elements. The advantages of a vehicle speed monitoring system based on RFID technology and its comparative analysis with other vehicle speed detection systems are carried out. A prototype of a real model was created based on the Arduino microcontroller and its capabilities were evaluated during the experiment.

articleTitle: Automated Classification of Lumbar Spine Degenerative Conditions Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper presents convolutional neural networks (CNN) models for the automatic classification of lumbar spine degenerative conditions including lumbar spine degeneration (LSD), Spider, Tseg, and OSF-Other Spine Features. Using a tagged dataset derived from Kaggle, the effort aims to automate medical picture interpretation thereby enhancing diagnosis accuracy and efficiency. The proposed CNN architecture consists in several convolutional and pooling layers; next are fully linked layers, thereby capturing and learning relevant features. Performance is defined by metrics like accuracy, recall, f1- score, and precision; a confusion matrix provides visualizing capacity for misclassification identification and classification results. The model displays a notable degree of accuracy in identifying lumbar spine illnesses, therefore demonstrating the prospects of deep learning in medical diagnostics. Apart from supporting clinicians in diagnosis, this automated technology aims to reduce radiologist workload and improve patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Development of a System for Analyzing Search Queries in Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article is devoted to the design of a system for analyzing search queries in social networks. The scheme of the functioning of the developed software is disclosed and the algorithm for analyzing text data is described. The software development process is presented. The results of testing the software module on its own search queries are also given.

articleTitle: Automated Pharmaceutical Drug and Vitamin Classification Using the EfficientNetB3 Model in Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this research, the fine-tuned EfficientNetB3 model is utilised for detecting the pharmaceutical drugs and vitamins. Emphasizing the need of correct medication identification in healthcare, this paper seeks to improve patient safety and avoid drug distribution mistakes. Collected via the open-source Kaggle platform, ten different products as Alaxon, Bactidol, Bioflu, Biogesic, and others have high- resolution images in the dataset, painstakingly annotated to guarantee correct classification. Refined using batch normalization, dropout, and dense layers, the EfficientNetB3 model attained an overall accuracy of 99%, proving its ability in differentiating between like-looking pharmaceutical goods. Classification reports, confusion matrices, and training- validation loss curves among other detailed analyses show the model's strong performance over all classes. With a consistent method for automated medicine and vitamin identification, the results of this study could have major consequences for pharmaceutical management. Expanding the dataset and improving model generalization will be main priorities of next development.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Skin Cancer Classification: A Case Study Using EfficientNetB3
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Melanoma is one of the still major worldwide health concerns related to skin cancer; early diagnosis is therefore essential to raise survival rates and patient outcomes. Leveraging the capability of the finely adjusted EfficientNetB3 model, this work focuses on employing deep learning approaches to automatically classify skin lesions as benign or malignant. Extracted from the open-source Kaggle platform was a dataset including 660 photos (with 360 benign and 300 malignant cases). Preprocessing and augmentation methods were used on the photos to improve model generalizing and lower overfitting. With an F1-score of 0.92 for benign lesions, an accuracy of 91% overall, and a precision of 0.93, the refined EfficientNetB3 model attained. The accuracy, recall, and F1-score for malignant lesions were respectively 0.89, 0.91, and 0.90. With little misclassification—especially for malignant cases, which are vital for early intervention—the confusion matrix validated the dependability of the model. These findings show the possibilities of the EfficientNetB3 model in presenting an accurate, dependable, and automated solution for skin cancer detection, so providing an advanced tool that could help doctors in early diagnosis and treatment planning.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Student Performance Prediction Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Predicting student performance is a critical task for educational institutions to facilitate timely interventions and improve academic outcomes. In this paper, we conduct a comprehensive comparative analysis of machine learning models applied to student performance prediction. The models evaluated include traditional approaches such as logistic regression, decision trees, and advanced techniques like XGBoost, Random Forest, and neural networks with attention mechanisms. Each model is assessed based on accuracy, precision, and F1-score. Dimensionality reduction techniques like t-SNE, along with feature selection methods such as feature importance, are employed to optimize the performance of the models. Our analysis shows that ensemble methods, particularly XGBoost, outperform other models in terms of accuracy, while attention- based models provide higher precision. We discuss the implications of these findings and suggest potential directions for future research, including the integration of real-time data and privacy-preserving techniques.

Author Keywords: Dimensionality reduction and Educational data mining

articleTitle: Domain Specific Text Summarization for Hindi Using Transformer-Based Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The rapid increase of digital information in India has generated an increasing demand for effective techniques to synthesize domain-specific literature in natural languages. In this research, the challenges and advancements in domain-specific text synthesis and summarization for Indian languages are explored. It summarizes deep learning along-with machine learning methods and focuses especially on customizing techniques to handle the linguistic complexity. The research highlights issues related to the lack of data available with low-resource languages. Furthermore, the study investigates the latest developments done in transformerbased models for text synthesis, including GPT-3 and BERT. The performance of the proposed model is examined in terms of different parameters such as precision (70.59%), recall (58.81%), and F1 score (62.34%}. Besides addressing these issues, it promotes digital communication and information sharing that is inclusive in India.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security by Emotion Analysis Approach Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Emotion recognition can significantly improve threat assessment capabilities by identifying potential threats by identifying emotional states indicative of hostile intent or distress. By recognizing emotions such as anger or fear, security systems can flag potentially dangerous individuals in vulnerable, crowded environments, enabling proactive action to mitigate risks a possible under This study delves into the use of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for emotion recognition, Ryerson Audio-Visual. The Database of Emotional Speech and Song (RAVDESS) focuses on emotion-specific emotions such as sadness, happiness, disgust, anger, and neutrality. Comparing basic and advanced CNN models through detailed accuracy analysis and performance simulations during training revealed a remarkable improvement in emotion recognition capability. In this study, models moving the face achieved an accuracy rate of 95% compared to 90% for the original CNN. Thus, in the future, this can be used in real applications to detect the subtle emotional content of security applications.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Split-Ring Resonator for Controlling the Strong Photon-Magnon Coupling Strength
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The strong coupling effect between magnons and photons in a nonlinear split-ring shaped resonator was studied numerically. It has been shown that in the nonlinear regime, a structure with a variable capacitor Cv=0.1 pF exhibits a maximum value of the strength of strong coupling between photons and magnons <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathrm{g} / 2 \pi=52 \text{MHz})$</tex> with a strength of coupling normalized per spin (coupling of a single-spin photon) of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$g/2\pi\sqrt{N}= 0.1605 \text{Hz}$</tex> at a frequency of 1.163 GHz. The possibility of tuning the frequency of resonance of the studied resonant structure by varying the degree of nonlinearity of the electrodynamic processes occurring within it has been demonstrated. Namely, we have shown that in the nonlinear regime, the control of the frequency of resonance of the structure and the magnitude of photon-magnon coupling by varying the input power Pin is possible. Additionally, an increase in photon-magnon coupling with decreasing variable capacitor capacitance was observed.

articleTitle: Transforming Agricultural Technology with CNNs: High-Precision Vegetable Classification for Enhanced Food Supply Chains
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Accurate classification of vegetable photos becomes more important as world food consumption increases to maximize farming methods, quality control, and food supply networks. This work presents a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model intended for the classification of photos of 15 different vegetable classes, including Bean, Bitter Gourd, Bottle Gourd, Brinjal, Broccoli, Cabbage, Capsicum, Carrot, cauliflower, Cucumber, Papaya, Potato, Pumpkin, Radish, and Tomato. With a dataset of 14,000 training photos, 3,000 validation images, and 3,000 test images taken from Kaggle, the CNN model shows an amazing general accuracy of 98%. The model uses numerous layers of convolution and max-pooling, then fully connected layers with dropout regularization to guard against overfitting. Classes including Bean, Carrot, and Potato showed almost 100% accuracy; Tomato showed a somewhat worse recall. Examining training and validation losses as well as accuracy helps to validate the model's resilience and capacity for broad generalization to unprocessed data. Reflecting its practical relevance in agricultural environments, the confusion matrix supports the great classification performance of the model. Using better vegetable sorting, lower post-harvest losses, and support of effective food processing, this study emphasizes CNN's potential to propel agricultural technologies forward. Larger datasets and more CNN architectures could be investigated in future study to improve classification capacity.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Control System of Heat and Power Object with Distributed Parameters on the Basis of Matrix Polynomial Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article presents a method of integrating control systems in heat and power applications with distributed parameters using matrix polynomial models. They speak about the consideration of complex phenomena such as heat exchange and conduction for introducing the improvement in control. It also allows achieving better modeling of the system's behavior while maintaining stability and minimizing transients. The work also builds the approach converting systems of equations into matrix polynomial ones that helps perform computational analysis and synthesis of controllers. By simulation modeling, the efficiency of this method is proved, showing that it is equally suitable to cope with external interferences as well as increase the degree of control precision. The consequences of the study suggest that matrix polynomial models will enhance the effective control of thermal power facilities as it minimizes energy losses.

articleTitle: Algorithms for Optimization of Operation Modes of Electric Power Systems Under Conditions of Information Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article considers optimization methods of operation modes of electric power systems, considering probabilistic factors. The problems related to the uncertainty of initial data, dynamic changes in the system, and the influence of random external factors on the transmission and consumption of electricity are studied. Special attention is paid to improving technological processes for controlling power flows in the network. The existing control systems do not sufficiently account for uncertainties, which reduces the quality of system operation. As a solution, it is proposed to improve the software and algorithmic base of control based on modern intellectual technologies. This will increase the adaptability of the system and minimize active power losses, which will improve the overall efficiency of electric power systems under conditions of data uncertainty. The article emphasizes the need for a more comprehensive approach to optimization, including the analysis of the interaction between the processes of transmission and consumption of energy resources to improve the efficiency of management of power industry facilities.

articleTitle: Fusing Face and Iris: A Deep/Machine Learning Approach for Advanced Biometric Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the digital era, the increasing demand for secure and reliable biometric systems has driven the shift towards multimodal fusion, such as combining face and iris recognition, to enhance accuracy and robustness. Traditional single-modality systems often struggle with challenges like variations in lighting, facial expressions, and noise, leading to higher error rates, including False Acceptance Rate (FAR) and False Rejection Rate (FRR). To address these limitations, we propose a novel machine learning-based score-level fusion method that integrates face and iris features. Using Local Binary Patterns (LBP) for face feature extraction and Gabor filters for iris, we generate robust feature vectors for each modality. These are then combined through a weighted sum approach, balancing contributions from both modalities to significantly improve recognition performance and reduce errors. This method effectively overcomes the limitations of traditional techniques by exploiting the complementary strengths of face and iris recognition. Our experiments, conducted on the CASIA Webface dataset and CASIA iris dataset with 5-fold cross-validation, demonstrated a notable improvement, achieving a 1% error rate, outperforming existing state-of-the-art biometric recognition systems.

articleTitle: UMPS: A Unified Multi-Physics Simulation Framework for Photonic Device Thermal Management with Tri-Domain Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The wavelength instability of Distributed Feedback (DFB) lasers in telecommunication degrades system performance. While DFB lasers are popular for their stability in singlewavelength output generation, thermal fluctuation severely impacts them. Excessive heat also causes complete device failure. However, effective thermal management is a critical challenge in the design and operation of DFB lasers. The interaction among multiple properties of electrical, optical, and thermal domains makes it more challenging. To address this challenge, this study introduces a Unified MultiPhysics Simulation ( UMPS ) model that integrates electrical, optical, and thermal dynamics into a single, comprehensive framework. This innovative approach demonstrates the capability of accurate predictions of temperature distributions, identification of thermal hotspots, and optimization of thermal management strategies. The simulation conducted by the UMPS model captures both steady-state and transient thermal behaviors, providing valuable insights into how photonic devices respond to dynamic operating conditions. The proposed UMPS model not only advances the understanding of thermal dynamics in DFB lasers but also offers a versatile tool that can be applied to other photonic devices facing similar challenges. This model can potentially impact the design of next-generation photonic systems, ensuring their efficiency and reliability in increasingly demanding applications.

articleTitle: The Temperature Effect on the Spectral Gain of Different Type Co-Doped EDFAs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This experimental study investigates temperaturedependent gain variations within the conventional C-band of Erbium-Doped Fiber Amplifiers (EDFA) over a temperature range of −10°C to 60°C. Gain changes were measured and compared for commercially available erbium-doped fibers ( EDFs) and rare-earth codoped EDFs (specifically, hafnia-bismuth and zirconium co-doped fibers). Our results demonstrate that commercial EDF exhibits greater temperature sensitivity in the 15401550 nm wavelength range compared to the co-doped fibers. Furthermore, the temperature-dependent gain coefficients for commercial EDF and co-doped fibers display opposite trends across the remaining C-band wavelengths. These findings have implications for the design and operation of EDFAs in environments with fluctuating temperatures.

articleTitle: Developing a Smart and Adaptive Load-Balancing System in Cloud Computing with QoS Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Algorithm for resource provisioning and cloud assignment for providing content in cloud based content delivery network is developed where dynamic use of large and small scale fluctuations in user demand rates are considered along with minimum lease period constraint. Virtual machines are simulated computers within a physical computer that can run their operating systems and applications. Intelligent Resource Allocation (IRA) is a QoS-aware resource allocation technique that uses advanced technologies like machine learning and artificial intelligence to optimize resource distribution in real-time. Profit-driven scheduling algorithms for cloud public service (PS) scheduling focus on optimizing resource allocation to maximize profit while prioritizing tasks related to public services. First-Come-First- Serve is the scheduling technique in which incoming tasks are served according to the first come first served procedure and the first arriving task is served first. Using entropy-based adaptive neuro-fuzzy inferences system (E-ANFIS) that combines fuzzy logic and neural networks, many factors can be analyse in real- basic for optimizing resource allocation and utilization. The conclusions established that the proposed technique, E-ANFIS, exhibits superior performance to the others, achieving an energy efficiency of 89%. Future works of this study can be direct more research efforts towards enhancing the application of the framework to multi-cloud and edge computing to integrate and optimise resources within different computing paradigms.

articleTitle: Improving Ecological Surveys with Deep Learning: Reptile and Amphibian Classification Using CNNs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Reptiles and amphibians together make herpetofauna, which is essential for the stability and health of ecosystems. These species' sensitivity to toxins and habitat disturbances helps them to not only control prey numbers but also act as markers of environmental changes. Large datasets or subtle interspecies changes challenge conventional classification techniques in handling, which makes ecological monitoring and conservation activities difficult. This paper presents a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model meant to raise the amphibian and reptile categorization accuracy. With a 6,052-image dataset, our model attained an 83% accuracy. Through automatically learning and feature extraction from images, the CNN method improves species identification accuracy and efficiency. Through more precise biodiversity estimates, this progress promotes sustainable development goals connected to life on land and aquatic habitats. In line with more general ecological and environmental goals, our work shows the possibilities of deep learning technology to solve conservation issues and support the sustainable management of natural resources.

articleTitle: Enhancing Inclusiveness and Sustainability in Smart City Evaluations: Integrating Novel Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Dimensions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The rapid urbanization has resulted in various challenges including environmental pollution, social inequality, and a weakened capability of problem-solving. Current Smart City Indexes are lacking in focusing on environmental, social, and governance dimensions. This paper will be introducing a new ESG-based Smart City Index, which can improve the evaluations of cities in an inclusive and sustainable manner. A pilot study conducted among the WeGO members brings out its effectiveness in driving urban innovation.

articleTitle: An Algorithm of Recognition Uzbek Sign Language
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article highlights an algorithm for recognizing the dactyl alphabet of Uzbek Sign Language using the YOLO architecture, based on deep convolutional neural networks. For training the model, developed a dataset that consist of images which representing of signs of Uzbek sign language. Metrics such as precision, recall, and average nrecision were used to evaluate the model's nerformance.

articleTitle: Building of Geographic Information System for Monitoring of Dams in the Republic of Kazakhstan
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: We describe the structure and main components of the geographic information system devoted to collecting and monitoring dams and dikes in the Republic of Kazakhstan. We also propose the structure of the main tables of the relational database system, types of monitoring work, including drone flybys, and system functionality for different users. Methods of using available open-source data to identify unregistered dams are discussed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Affecting Student Performance Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper makes a comparative analysis of several factors that are likely to influence performance of students based on a set of data collection parameters that include study habits, attendance, parental involvement among others. In this analysis, decision trees and logistic regression are employed for estimating final examination grades. Parental involvement, attendance and study hours were identified as having the greatest influence on performance.

articleTitle: Secure and Decentralized Patient Medical Record Management System Powered by Ethereum Blockchain and IPFS
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Today, effective patient care and informed decision-making depend on Electronic Health Records (EHRs). Maintaining the quality and dependability of patient treatment and health insurance policies depends on proving the validity of Electronic Health Records (EHRs). However, traditional EHR systems suffer from privacy violations and data breaches. We propose a distributed solution that meets these problems by using blockchain technology and Inter Planetary File solution (IPFS), which proposes safely storing and retrieving private medical records. In this, actual medical records are uploaded to IPFS with the use of Pinata for off-chain storage, whereas the system utilizes smart contracts implemented on a blockchain to store patient metadata, which comprises primary identification details such as Aadhar numbers safely. This approach ensures record transparency and immutability without compromising patient confidentiality. The system design allows for safe retrieval of medical records using the Content Identifier (CID), which is attached to every patient's Aadhar number. We demonstrate the implementation using transaction management on Ethereum's private network with Ganache, Truffle, and MetaMask. This solution meets the distributed demand for safe medical data storage and retrieval, therefore opening opportunities for patient-centric healthcare systems with integrity and accessibility maintained.

articleTitle: Shells of High-Rise Buildings: Multiparametric Shaping
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article dedicated using the example of the tower reconstruction project, an original method of forming the shell of high-rise buildings with a concave profile is proposed based on the use of a polynomial guide and the concept of smooth conjugation of planes. In this case, the coefficients of the corresponding polynomial are expressed in terms of nine design parameters of the simulated shell of the tower.

articleTitle: Predicting Multiple Diseases Using Machine Learning: A Symptom-Based Model for Medical Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The new innovations of ML and DL has improved and delivering better results in many areas, with healthcare being one of them. The paper discussed in this work focuses on the use of the machine learning methods to predict multiple diseases given 132 symptoms. In this study, 42 diseases were considered as a target granule, and there are numerous training and testing samples. The proposed approach should be useful to physicians by giving a reliable method of disease prediction that can meet the objective of improving physicians' decision making and patients' care.

articleTitle: Enhancing Breast Cancer Detection Using A Transformer-Based Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Breast cancer is a very common and one of the leading causes of mortality and illness worldwide. Early detection of breast cancer is critical, increasing the chances of long-term survival and successful treatment. Mammography is a primary method for early detection and a widely used imaging technique employing low-dose X-rays. Interpreting mammograms remains challenging due to the complex nature of malignancy anomalies. This advanced imaging technique has revolutionized the screening of breast cancer by facilitating the better visualization of breast tissues. The main challenge that radiologists face in reading mammographic patterns is too many false positives and negatives, which leads to unnecessary biopsies, anxiety among patients, and missing the correct diagnosis. In current times, artificial intelligence (AI) has shown significant success in the medical imaging field. In particular, deep learning (DL) models have outperformed traditional image processing techniques. Allowing accurate and automated predictions, these models are trained on massive datasets to understand the different characteristics of tumors. In this work, a different DL-based model is deployed and developed to detect breast cancer using mammogram images. Also, several DL approaches are discussed, mentioning their benefits and limitations concerning mammography. This work thoroughly analyzes the literature and uses techniques and different evaluation methods to analyze the model's performance across different datasets.

articleTitle: The Way to Support Virtual Resource Mapping Within Dynamic Network Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Network virtualization therefore refers to the integration of physical hardware and software network resources and network functionality into one software control entity - a virtual network. Virtual networks enable several different kinds of heterogenous Logical networks to share the same Physical network. The main work in incarnating virtualization is to provision the physical network resources to a given virtual network by mapping the virtual resources to the physical equipment dynamically in order to leverage the available equipments. Opinions derived from experimental as well as real life scenario reveal that mechanisms of virtualization will be the key enabler of end to end Quality of Service assurance in the network architecture. This paper considers how to arrange the virtual services approaching the task of virtual resource mapping in network environment, with possibility to focus on the network elements performing the network functions and interfacing with prospective networking solutions.

articleTitle: Harvesting Insights: Automated Fruit Quality Classification Using EfficientNetB5
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: We explore the three categories—best quality, bad quality, and mixed quality—into which fruits fit depending on their quality using eighteen classes. Fruit quality identification and classification help to ensure product consistency, reduce waste, and increase supply chain efficiency, therefore promoting responsible usage and production. Faster, more precise quality evaluation made possible by automating this process immediately affects customer happiness, lowers food loss, and advances sustainable agriculture by helping sectors to Using the EfficientNetB5 architecture—known for great performance in picture classification tasks—our approach preserves computational efficiency while yet being strong. There are 5,553 photos in the dataset utilized for this work split into 3,600 for training, 977 for validation, and 976 for testing. Using several fine-tuning methods, we obtained on the test set an amazing 99% accuracy. These findings show how well the EfficientNetB5 model can discriminate between various fruit quality levels, therefore providing a workable solution for automated fruit quality inspection in practical settings that guarantees food security and supports zero hunger by means of which.

articleTitle: Fraudulent Job Posting Detection Using Logistic Regression
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In the present study, the application of logistic regression models to analyze language technologically driven illegal job advertising identification is explored. With a whole collection of linguistic characteristics—word rates and n-grams derived from job ads, we built a scenario that uses a logistic regression model to identify ads as either genuine or fake. A remarkable accuracy of 98.19% on the test set was obtained, confirming the subject's resolve in distinguishing between dishonest and honest job advertising. An analysis was conducted to determine the effect of several critical factors, including modulation amplitude and optimal technique, on the model's performance. To achieve a harmonious equilibrium between the model's accuracy and its capability to operate effectively on unfamiliar data, modifications were implemented to these hyperparameters. Furthermore, an analysis was conducted on the framework's loss function to obtain precise insights into its convergence characteristics during the training stage. Our results highlight the need of logistic regression methods in spotting phony job postings and clarify how hyperparameter modification affects model performance. This work contributes significantly to the corpus of knowledge on recognizing frauds in job site promotion and presents vital new insights on the appropriate use of logistic regression analyses for this objective. The report also identifies areas that could benefit from additional investigation, such as comparing various machine learning approaches and introducing more text components, to enhance the possibility of identifying falsehoods.

articleTitle: Integration of Computer Vision for Book Detection and Text-to-Speech Conversion Using API for Blind People
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The visually impaired and blind community has devised various methods to access printed materials despite their visual challenges. However, current solutions such as braille, audiobooks, and human assistants suffer from limitations in availability, coverage, privacy, and independence. This paper introduces a book recognition system that integrates computer vision and machine learning technologies to serve individuals with low vision. By simply pointing the camera at books, the system can audio titles, summaries, and captions. The system focuses on uses OpenCV to extract text for the real-time book detection from Tesseract's optical character recognition (OCR) capabilities. Information extracted through text-to-speech conversion is presented as audio output, facilitating information retrieval. Employing user-centric and low-barrier approaches, this tool addresses the shortcomings associated with traditional methods. The system architecture thoughtfully incorporates next-generation technologies such as object recognition, OCR, and speech synthesis, seamlessly integrating them into a cohesive and userfriendly solution tailored for visually impaired individuals. This groundbreaking solution tackles the issue of accessing printed materials head-on, paving the way for independent living and equal opportunities. An extensive literature review explores foundational concepts in computer vision, object recognition, shape matching, and multimodal classification.

articleTitle: Advanced AI Techniques for Grid-Connected Renewable Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This research paper explores the ability to integrate innovative AI methods to optimise grid-integrated renewable energy systems. Consequently, this study assesses the benefits of energy demand forecasting, fault detection, and real-time energy management using Long Short Term Memory LSTM networks, SVM and RL models focusing on three broad areas. The LSTM model performed well in the energy demand forecast with low MAE and RMSE than other models while the SVM model performed well in fault detection with a 92% accuracy. LBC revealed that the RL-based system contributed to the reduction of energy cost while regulating the grid stability through optimizing energy in different demand situations. This paper also presents several key issues associated with data quality, model generalization, computational overhead, and interfaces to extant systems. This emphasizes the gaps on the effectiveness of data acquisition techniques, flexibility of AI mod- els and robustness of the algorithms to perform within resource constraints. There are some issues arise while integrating new AI technologies with existing traditional systems which must be considered and standardized. Possible future works are provided to overcome these issues, which include the refinement of pre processing techniques, flexi- bility of models, and solution extensibility. The studies highlight multiple possibilities of using AI in the enhancement of energy systems and their managing factor, decrease of operation costs, as well as increase of the robustness of grids, opening the way to further development of the more effective and stable energy managing solutions.

articleTitle: Advances in Quantum Computing for Enhancing Network Security and Encryption Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Therefore, the purpose of this research paper is to put into light the implication of using quantum computing for the enhancement of the likelihood of network security and encryption. Challenges for conventional cryptography are immense in the framework of quantum technology, that is why construction of quantum-safe cryptography, as well as enhanced QKD is necessary. It also provides an overview of various quantumresistant cryptographic algorithms of which are lattice-based, hash-based, and multivariate quadratic one, on the aspects of efficiency, security, and probable areas of concern in the real world. In addition, it offers fresh viewpoints about one-party BB84 and E91 QKD protocols on the enhancement of secure communication while using quantum ideas. In the light of the approaches towards the paradigm, the lattice-based algorithms provide a reasonable degree of protection against wastage of time/effort and the hash-based and the MQ based algorithms have their pluses and minuses. This is not to say that via QKD protocols the dream of secure communication is a remote one; rather it is more a case that the difficulties in putting it into practice are less theoretical and lie more firmly in the realms of cost and distance. Hence it can be seen that although quantum computing has the capability to develop new improved features of the network security there are technical challenges and concern which needs to be resolve to reap the set benefits. More future research and development will be necessary for implementing the quantum technologies for enhancing the encryption techniques and making the communication secure to adapt the emerging model.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Detection and Estimation in Millimeter-Wave MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper focuses on problems in millimeter-wave (mmWave) MIMO systems with regards to detection and estimation errors. As mentioned before, traditional methods do not address well high-dimensional signal processing and hostile channel environments. For improving the detection and estimation the proposed method includes deep neural networks (DNNs) and deep residual network (ResNets). Our finding shows that these AI models have better performance in decreasing BER and MSE than existing techniques especially under conditions of change in SNR. Such an improvement raises the possibilities of what can be achieved through AI to handle problems that are beyond the capability as seen when compared to other methods. Specifically, the observational study also discusses critical challenges of model scalability and real-time processing while proposing further research avenues to address these concerns. In summary, the employment of the AI to the mmWave MIMO systems has the potential of expanding the horizon of communication technologies through the provision of more dependable and effective techniques. Keywords: AI-driven detection, millimeter-wave mimo, deep neural networks, channel state information, bit error rate, mean squared error

articleTitle: Cultivating Health: Automated Sugarcane Disease Detection Through Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Widely grown in tropical and subtropical climates, sugarcane is a significant commodity providing a major source of sugar, biofuels, and many by-products. But it is quite vulnerable to diseases such Mosaic, Red Rot, Rust, and Yellow Leaf Disease, which seriously lower crop output and quality and so jeopardize farmers' lives as well as the agricultural economy. Conventional methods of disease detection rely on time-consuming, labour-intensive manual inspection prone to mistake. This paper addresses leveraging deep learning for automated sugarcane disease diagnosis in order to solve this problem using the MobileNetV2 architecture, a lightweight convolutional neural network developed for real-time applications. Five classes-Healthy, Mosaic, Red Rot, Rust, and Yellow Leaf Disease-were created from 2,521 images of sugarcane leaves. Data preparation with resizing, standardizing, and augmentation was done to increase model generalization. Proposed is transfer learning using MobileNetV2 pre-trained on ImageNet and refined for the specific aim of disease classification. The model achieved 87% test set accuracy. This work emphasizes MobileNetV2's possibilities for real-time disease monitoring in the field and shows how well it detects sugarcane diseases, so offering a scalable, accurate, and effective method of early disease detection and management.

articleTitle: Automated Fruit and Vegetable Classification with Convolutional Neural Networks: A Comprehensive Study
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Accurate classification of fruits and vegetables is absolutely essential for both agricultural efficiency and quality control. This work presents a novel method using Convolutional Neural Networks to improve fruit and vegetable classification from images. In the proposed CNN architecture, several convolutional, pooling, and thick layers enable the model to effectively record and investigate complex visual characteristics. The model is trained on a diversified dataset consisting of thirty categories of fruits and vegetables using 100 photographs per category for training and 10 images per category for testing and validation. By ensuring stability and hence reducing overfitting, batch normalisation and dropout layers together optimize the performance of the model. Despite its scalability and self-sufficient feature learning possibilities, this CNN-based method provides robustness and accuracy above more conventional techniques. Establishing a new bar for fruit and vegetable classification, the model reveals over all categories excellent accuracy, recall, and F1-scores. Expanding the dataset, including transfer learning approaches, and optimizing the model for real-time, mobile apps will be the main priorities of next improvements. With an overall accuracy of 97%, this study emphasizes the transforming power of deep learning technologies on agricultural classification, therefore highlighting the efficiency and pragmatic importance of the model.

articleTitle: Modeling an Acoustic Noise Cancellation Filter Based on the Raspberry Pi 4B Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The following paper, based on the processor Raspberry Pi 4B, develops an Adaptive Filter for teleconferencing systems noise cancellation and analyzes its effectiveness. The theoretical development of the acoustic noise cancellation algorithms is performed, in particular LMS, NLMS, and RLS algorithms, where their implementation on the Raspberry Pi platform is studied. The tests carried out within the research testify that these filters are efficient for noise level reduction, hence increasing the quality of the sound. The article presented shows the possibilities of the Raspberry Pi platform to develop low-cost, efficient teleconferencing systems and is targeted to be a foundation for new approaches in this direction. It is also targeted to be performed on the Raspberry Pi 4B platform for high-quality sound transmission with effective acoustic noise cancellation in teleconferencing systems.

articleTitle: Next-Generation Passivation Strategies for Enhanced Solar Cell Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The essential need to improve the efficiency and stability of photovoltaic systems has led to substantial changes in the development of solar cell passivation processes over time. We briefly review the development of passivation techniques, emphasizing the shift from traditional approaches to advanced techniques that address specific limitations. By exploring studies on various materials and technologies, this review uncovers how innovations in passivation have contributed to the overall performance of solar cells, paving the way for future advancements in this field.

articleTitle: Smart Sorting: Enhancing Almond Quality with DenseNet-201-Based Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Considered as two varieties: damaged and undamaged, almonds are a rather consumed agricultural product. Maintaining consumer satisfaction and industry standards depends on good detection of damaged almonds., which could be influenced by mechanical damage., mold, or pests. On the other hand, slow, labor-intensive hand inspection methods prone to mistake demand automated classification systems. This work meets that demand by automating the categorization process using DenseNet-121, a convolutional neural network (CNN), therefore lowering labor expenses and increasing accuracy. Particularly considering the tiny dataset of 1,000 photos split equally between damaged and undamaged almonds, DenseNet-121's architecture-with its dense connections and capacity to reuse features-is well-suited for the almond classification challenge. Pre-trained on ImageNet and polished for this particular purpose, the model-trained across 60 epochs using a 32-batch size-achieved an accuracy of 95.27%. Random horizontal flips, resizing., and center cropping among other data augmentation techniques improved the model's generalizing capability. This work demonstrates the model's ability to substitute human methods in actual environments by showing how well it employs little visual information to classify almonds. Automating almond sorting speeds and provides higher consistency in quality control as well as efficiency of sorting. This work opens the road for further research of machine learning techniques in agricultural processing with possible applications in food quality assurance.

articleTitle: Pistachio Species Classification: Leveraging Machine Learning for Quality Assurance and Market Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Leveraging a large dataset of 2,148 high-resolution photos, this work proposes a fresh method for classifying pistachio species using a MobileNetV2 deep learning model. The suggested system seeks to automate the classification process, hence improving accuracy and efficiency over conventional hand sorting methods. The dataset consists of pictures of several pistachio varieties, so guaranteeing strong representation for good model training. After data preparation and augmentation, transfer learning was used to fine-tune the MobileNetV2 architecture producing a quite good classification model. The model had an overall accuracy of 94%; specific class measures show excellent performance. For several classes, specifically, precision and recall scores peaked around 99%; F1-scores across most species often exceeded 0.90. The classification report shows the success of the suggested model by displaying F1-scores demonstrating balanced performance in different species and accuracy values ranging from 0.81 to 0.99, so separating between various species. This study shows the possibilities of deep learning in agricultural uses, especially in optimizing pistachio processing and guaranteeing the quality of goods on the market. The results imply that the MobileNetV2 model not only simplifies classification problems but also provides a scalable solution fit for like agricultural difficulties.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control Strategies for Optimal Load Management in Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper involves development of an adaptive control for load management in a smart grid and faces the emerging challenges of integrating renewable resources, varying demand and stability conditions for smart grid. By integrating high-level control approaches including but not limited to Model Predictive Control (MPC) and machine learning algorithms, the proposed system optimizes load sharing in response to grid status in an effort to optimize energy usage, reduce costs, and increase the grid's dependability. The framework is validated based on the simulation studies carried out under different conditions such as peak and off-peak, low renewable generation and high renewable generation. This proved that the proposed adaptive control strategies were effective in enhancing energy consumption and supply lower costs relative to the standard approach with reference to peak load and renewable energy resources fluctuation. These issues include the size of the control systems that becomes an important factor to consider as well as the problems of Cybersecurity, and integration of energy storage system which gave an indication of areas for further research. Thus, the adaptive control method offers the effective means for the challenges of the modern power grids, increase the efficiency of power consumption, develop renewable energy distribution on the large scale. All these developments ensure that the future power systems are more reliable, renewable, and smart.

articleTitle: The New Trends in Korea Higher Education ODA: The Establishment of an Innovative Business IT Education Ecosystem at the Tashkent University of Information Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This study aims to analyze the role and limitations of universities in Korean educational ODA (Official Development Assistance) and to identify the success factors and strategies through a case study of a higher education ODA project led by K University. The research focuses on a collaborative project between K University and Uzbekistan's T University, which was part of KOICA's (Korea International Cooperation Agency) higher education ODA initiatives in 2022. The findings from this study provide important insights for the future implementation of higher education ODA projects. Five key success factors were identified in the K-T project. First, the project enhanced sustainability by simultaneously addressing hardware-oriented infrastructure and softwareoriented capacity building. This approach emphasized that ongoing education and capacity building are essential alongside physical support. Second, K University consistently participated in all stages of the project-from planning to evaluation-following a bottom-up approach, which contributed to improved effectiveness and understanding of the project. Third, the project team was organized as a crossdisciplinary board, integrating expertise from various academic fields to increase responsiveness to issues arising during project implementation. This multidimensional approach strengthened risk management and absorptive capacity. Fourth, consistent leadership was maintained throughout the project, with the presidents of K University and T University, along with KOICA's director and deputy director, ensuring the project's stability and continuity from start to finish.
