This leadership consistency played a crucial role in the project's long-term success. Lastly, the Project Manager (PM) actively coordinated between K University and T University, while the Project Management Office (PMO) effectively managed the relationships between K University, KOICA, and T University. This active involvement enhanced project progress and demonstrated strong risk management capacity, positively influencing the likelihood of success in future projects. This study provides a valuable foundation for developing organizational frameworks and strategies that universities can adopt when conducting higher education ODA projects in the future.

articleTitle: Enhancing Toxic Comment Detection with BiLSTM-Based Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Enhancing the ability to identify abusive comments is essential, as it addresses the growing issue of online toxicity while fostering healthier interactions. In this paper, a deep learning architecture is proposed using Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) to enhance the identification of toxic comments with multiple labels. Due to its architectural characteristics, Bi-LSTM achieves high accuracy by thoroughly preprocessing data and effectively managing unknown words during FastText embeddings. It is especially effective at detecting subtle forms of intoxication, such as obscenity, insults, hate speech, and threats, by using contextual signals. Incorporating these techniques online may enable the automatic detection and deletion of toxic content, thereby promoting positive interactions. This model serves as a benchmark for improving the handling of classification problems with various labels through fine-tuning the neural network architecture.

articleTitle: A Fine-Tuned ConvNextSmall Approach for Accurate Footwear Classification: Model Performance and Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Emphasizing three independent categories: shoes, sandals, and boots, we study in this work the application of deep learning techniques for footwear classification. We accomplished this with a well-known performance and efficiency in image classification challenges and finely tuned ConvNextSmall convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture. The dataset employed consists of 27,000 labeled images overall; these were divided into training (12,000), validation (7,500), and testing (7,500) groups. Originally tailored to maximize performance for this specific footwear category task, the model was pre-trained using a large-scale image dataset. Several techniques of data augmentation improved generalization; the model was trained with an adaptive learning rate strategy to avoid overfitting. On the test set, evaluation with a 99% accuracy yielded quite exceptional performance for the model. This high degree of performance reveals the prospects of employing finely adjusted ConvNextSmall architectures for accurate and efficient classification in the footwear domain, therefore offering a solid solution for automated retail, inventory management, and fashion industry uses. While reducing inequality in technology access and deployment, the results enable good work and economic growth, so enabling sustainable development using responsible consumption and production, industry innovation, and solution providing.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Breast Cancer Classification: Leveraging CNNs for Early Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Among the most common and fatal diseases afflicting women throughout is breast cancer. Early detection greatly increases survival rates, hence reliable and effective diagnostic instruments are rather important for patient treatment. Although conventional screening techniques like mammography are efficient, false positives and false negatives present problems that can cause treatment delays. Using deep learning methods to enhance diagnosis accuracy and provide scalable screening systems, this work investigates the application of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for breast cancer categorization. CNNs provide great accuracy in spotting anomalies and automatically recognize patterns and characteristics, hence improving medical imaging. This work created and trained a proprietary CNN model using a dataset obtained from the Kaggle platform comprising 549 photos encompassing both malignant and non-cancerous samples. With an accuracy of 89%, the proposed model shows promise to help radiologists in early breast cancer detection, so improving healthcare outcomes and supporting the worldwide goals of improving health and well-being, so lowering inequalities in medical access, and so promoting innovation in healthcare technologies. In line with more general goals for excellent healthcare systems worldwide, our work helps the continuous endeavor to provide more sustainable and scalable options for early diagnosis of breast cancer.

articleTitle: QoS-Aware Resource Allocation Framework for Profit Maximization and Efficient Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Algorithm for resource provisioning and cloud assignment for providing content in cloud based content delivery network is developed where dynamic use of large and small scale fluctuations in user demand rates are considered along with minimum lease period constraint. Virtual machines are simulated computers within a physical computer that can run their operating systems and applications. Intelligent Resource Allocation (IRA) is a QoS-aware resource allocation technique that uses advanced technologies like machine learning and artificial intelligence to optimize resource distribution in real-time. Profit-driven scheduling algorithms for cloud public service (PS) scheduling focus on optimizing resource allocation to maximize profit while prioritizing tasks related to public services. First-Come-First-Serve is the scheduling technique in which incoming tasks are served according to the first come first served procedure and the first arriving task is served first. Using entropy-based adaptive neuro-fuzzy inferences system (E-ANFIS) that combines fuzzy logic and neural networks, many factors can be analyse in real- basic for optimizing resource allocation and utilization. The conclusions established that the proposed technique, E-ANFIS, exhibits superior performance to the others, achieving an energy efficiency of 89%. Future works of this study can be direct more research efforts towards enhancing the application of the framework to multi-cloud and edge computing to integrate and optimise resources within different computing paradigms.

articleTitle: Efficient Diagnosis of Coffee Leaf Diseases Using Pre-Trained ResNet50 Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The method used in this study for automatically detecting the diseases in coffee leaves is the deep learning method based on the pre-trained ResNet50 model. They have used a dataset of images of coffee leaves having four classes, namely miner, no disease, phoma and rust. The steps included in the data preprocessing were resizing of the images to ensure that the model receives input images of equal dimension and augmenting the dataset in a bid to enhance its generalization. ResNet50 model was fine-tuned to have the ability of down streaming features specific to coffee diseases after being pre-trained on ImageNet dataset. This model was developed with an additional dense layer with activation, and the Adam optimizer for the model's training. Evaluation parameters and training metrics depicted that the developed model is highly accurate in classification and an early stopping has been implemented to shy away from over-fitting of the model. To measure the efficiency of the proposed model, a confusion matrix and a classification report have been employed and the accuracy, recall, and F1-score are presented for different classes. Furthermore, the model was converted into TensorFlow Lite Model as it was possible to implement it for real time illness detection on the edge node. Essentially, the results prove that the ResNet50 model is capable of classifying the ills affecting the coffee leaf and this can make it easier for farmers to manage the diseases as they arise in agricultural practices.

articleTitle: CNN and Random Forest Convergence: A Cutting-Edge Approach to Early Ovarian Cancer Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Ovarian cancer is asymptomatic in its early stages, early identification greatly improves patient outcomes, but it is still a daunting issue. This paper offers a unique method to improve the prediction accuracy of early ovarian cancer by combining Random Forest (RF) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). A dataset with an 80:20 training-to-testing split, consisting of 5,200 healthy and 5,600 malignant samples, is used to train the model. The RF classifier successfully distinguishes between healthy and malignant cells, while the CNN component efficiently collects high-level information from medical pictures. For the “Healthy” class, the model achieves an accuracy of 93.80% and a recall of 95.20%, yielding an F1-score of 94.49%. The model achieves 95.10% accuracy and 93.60% recall for the “Infected” class, with an F1-score of 94.34%. The 97% total accuracy in both classes highlights how consistently the algorithm can differentiate between the two scenarios. The F1-score's macro, weighted, and micro averages all lie around 94.40%, indicating evenly distributed performance across the sample. The combination of CNN and RF approaches provides a novel approach to early identification of ovarian cancer, which may result in earlier treatments and better patient outcomes. The suggested paradigm shows a great deal of promise for clinical practice integration, giving medical practitioners an effective weapon in the battle against ovarian cancer.

articleTitle: Generating and Evaluating Synthetic Medical Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning models have been used in various fields. Nonetheless, adaptation is still required in delicate fields like medical imaging. Since the medical field has a time constraint that necessitates the use of technology, accuracy guarantees credibility. Medical data cannot be used in machine learning applications due to privacy concerns. The development of big data is closely related to the high accuracy of disease diagnosis, classification, and recommendation. Argumentation techniques are used to expand the size of medical image datasets because deep learning-based image analysis necessitates large amounts of data. This paper proposes to include an Fréchet MedicalNet distance (FMD) value with higher accuracy than the Fréchet inception distance (FID) value in evaluating medical images that are different from the methods used to generate synthetic medical images and to calculate the FID value quickly.

Author Keywords: Fréchet inception distance synthetic medical image

articleTitle: Linking Public Value and Theory of Change Perspective: Insights from KOICA's Project for Establishment of HRD of Digital Innovative MSMEs in Lao PDR
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This article aims to analyze the ODA Project for the Establishment of HRD of Digital Innovative MSMEs in Lao PDR as a case study. Qualitative methods were used for analyzing the case to provide a detailed narrative through participatory observation and documentary reviews. This article adopts Moore's strategic triangle model to analyze whether and how project performance management can be designed from a public value perspective. Based on the perspective that activities and performance in ODA projects need to be managed with public value perspective and a theory of change approach, we discuss public value-based project management strategies for sustainable and cooperative ODA projects, emphasizing a local community-driven approach.

articleTitle: Identification of Cyberattacks in IoT-Powered Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The rapid advancement in healthcare technology has brought significant benefits but also introduced new vulnerabilities. As healthcare organizations adopt digital technologies, they face growing risks to the security of medical processes and patient safety. This research explores the current state of cybersecurity in the healthcare sector, highlighting the threats these organizations face. In later times, cyberattacks on the Web of Wellbeing Things (IoHT) have ceaselessly been developing, and so it is vital to create strong countermeasures. In any case, there is a need of freely accessible datasets reflecting cyberattacks on IoHT, primarily due to security concerns. This paper exhibits the business of a dataset, ECU-IoHT, which builds upon an IoHT environment having distinctive assaults performed that abuse different vulnerabilities. The ECU-IoHT dataset, made in 2021, comprises of 9 highlights and 4 sorts of assaults, with a add up to of 111,207 records. It is partitioned into a preparing set of 88,965 records and a testing set of 22,242 records. This dataset was planned to assist the healthcare security community in analysing assault behaviour and creating vigorous countermeasures. Utilizing the ECU-IoHT dataset, this research investigate applies progressed calculations, counting RNN and CNN, to analyse and anticipate potential vulnerabilities in healthcare frameworks. The utilize of RNN and CNN models improves the prescient capabilities of cybersecurity systems by precisely distinguishing designs and inconsistencies that may flag security breaches, illustrating the basic require for coordination. AI-driven courses of action to protect fragile well-being data and ensure the movement of remedial organizations. The models illustrated tall execution, with CNN accomplishing an exactness of 98.9% for parallel classification and RNN accomplishing 98.9% for multi-class classification, both appearing solid exactness, review, and F1 scores.

articleTitle: Applications of Chaos Theory in Securing Nonlinear Signal Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper examines the use of chaos theory towards the ensuring the securitoy of nonlinear signal communication networks. Chaos encryption is based on the given properties of the chaos: the minimized differences between two neighboring states, this method contributes to stronger protection based on definite non-predictability. Analysis of result shows that proposed chaos based methods provides better SNR, BER, and computation complexity than the conventional encryption method and hence suitable for WSNs. The methodology includes simulation of chaotic systems, conversion of information through chaotic masking and synchronization with the receiver for decoding. With the help of simulation, it is shown that chaos-based encrypting agents have optimal security measure in moderate noise level and relatively less computational time. The development of the chaos-based encryption encounters problems and these problems are mainly in the areas of synchronization between the chaos transmitter and the receiver, the chaos sensitivity to noise and how to implement the large number of nodes in a network. The interoperability with the next-gen technologies including quantum computing and machine learning holds the prospects for future investigations. These advancement might help enhance the flexibility and reliability of the chaos based encryption systems and thus open the gate for the practical implementation of the technology in various fields of application. According to this study, there is immense potential for using the chaos-based encryption technology applied to nonlinear communication networks but the further research is needed to overcome the practical issues. Further works should be directed into the improvement of noise tolerance, expansibility, and realism so as to to pave way for the real world adoption of chaos based cryptography to facilitate the security of modern day communication systems.

articleTitle: Leveraging Big Data and AI: A Comprehensive Approach to Improving IoT, Data Mining, and Analytics for Healthcare, Finance, and Urban Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper seeks to unveil the capabilities of big data, artificial intelligence and IoT in different fields such as healthcare, urban planning, SCM and financial services. So, by involving several cases and several algorithms including WKMID3, k-mean clustering and pattern mining, we suggested the solutions that improve PRA and decision making in these sectors. We also describe big data application in Mediterranean fishing areas, Bluetooth traffic, and orientation toward healthcare applications for improvement. From our results, we can extrapolate that big data and AI can bring great benefits by optimizing systems in various domains.

articleTitle: Flying Ad-Hoc Networks: Modeling and Analyzing Latency
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The article considers the process of multistream data transmission from several unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to a ground station. A simulation model of the data transmission process at the application level of the FANET model (from flying nodes to a ground station) is described. The nature of the streaming data traffic is represented by a Markov packet process. The results of simulation modeling of the process of streaming video transmission from several UAV source nodes in the NS-3 network simulator are presented. A system for emulating the process of multi-stream data transmission from a UAV to a ground station is described. This paper considers latency in FANETs as a particularly significant network issue. It examines the factors influencing latency and conducts research based on Queuing Theory in analytical modeling. Additionally, the paper discusses network simulators that can be employed for researching.

articleTitle: Urban Air Quality and Health Impact Analysis Based on Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this paper, an attempt has been made to understand the relations between air quality in urban areas and individuals' health by using the dataset “Urban Air Quality and Health Impact Dataset” enlisted on Kaggle. The dataset comprisess some standard environmental parameters like temperate, humidity, wind speed, and solar exposure along with HealthRelated Risk Scores for top-tier American cities. Predicting Health Risk in Urbanization Using Machine Learning: Applying the linear regression and the random forest models, we attempt to forecast in which ways weather conditions may potentially influence health risks. Based on the results, we note that factors such as temperature and humidity are critical determinants of public health. These models also show a positive relationship between potential environmental variables and the probability of health risks, a measure of value to city planners and health departments. The data could then inform more efficient decisions to address environmental health risks common in cities. In the future, we also intend to overlay real-time data and consider the application of higher-order methods, including deep learning, for improving the precisions of the predictions and facilitating better urban health administration.

articleTitle: Towards Inclusive Smart Cities: Key Evaluation Criteria for Technology and Human-Centered Development
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Based on the 189 projects submitted to the Seoul Smart City Prize 2023, this paper aims to distinguish the key indicators affecting smart city project with a focus on human centered smart city development. By identifying the highly correlated indicators and the ones that have the greatest influence on the result, divergence and replicability and scalability was the important criteria in technology focused projects and service facilitating conditions and digital media literacy level was important for human-centered initiative focused projects. These findings can be a guidance to understand the critical elements of human centered smart city project design.

articleTitle: Paradigm Shift in Adopting Photography as the Professional Career by Women's in the Era of AI: A Critical Study
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This paper aims at describing the change in thestate and role of photography as a profession for women in the age of AI. As AI alters the process of developing, designing and sharing content among photographers, the occupation has openeda door for women to challenge the nepotism of gender and engagein professional photography. This paper focuses on discussing how AI influences different aspects of the work including skills acquisition, productivity, and performance, and artistry. It also concerns opportunities and threats for women present in the technology field in terms of ethical issues, technical limitations and expectations towards them. In this critical analysis basedon survey, interview and case studies, it examines the new career possibilities that AI brings to women photographers. These conclusions suggest that it is time to raise the requirement for AI literacy and equal access to AI resources to promote the AI and encourage the reasonable integration of AI into creativeprocesses. Through such dynamics, the article enhances the existing literature on gender diversity in creative economy, and the impact of AI in defining the advancement of photography. Theconclusion of the study then outlines suggestions for expanding women's representation in the photography profession; how to use AI to fuel the profession's growth; and how to meet thechanging needs of the profession.

articleTitle: SmartFeet - Pressure Monitoring for Foot Health and Ulcer Prevention
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Our study presents a revolutionary foot pressure monitoring system that uses machine learning and Arduino-based sensors. This system is essential for preventing ulcers, particularly in individuals with diabetes. We can prevent ulcers by identifying pressure fluctuations early on thanks to the smart placement of sensors in the insole. We continuously evaluate ulcer risk using the Support Vector Machine technique. By enhancing foot health monitoring, this approach may improve the lives of those who are at risk.

articleTitle: Sign Language Translator: A Comparative Analysis of Deep Learning and Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: Worldwide, deaf mute people interaction with people who do not know the sign language is quite hard. Even though gestures constitute the main source of communication of the deaf and the mute, many hearing people do not have the ability to read normal signs. To minimize this shortcoming, the Sign Language Translator intends to utilize advanced technologies including deep learning, computer vision as well as machine learning to convert sign language to either oral speech or written text. This system performs the instantaneous conversion of sign language into text thereby promoting contacts and the free interaction of disabled and able people. Our approach is not only arrived at from implanting existing methods on a custom dataset but also uses a larger and richer dataset, WLASL (Word-Level American Sign Language) thus enhancing model performance. Four machine learning models are borrowed in this project: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) captures and recalls information over longer periods, Convolution Neural Networks (CNN)samples and analysis parts of images to retrieve spatial information, Random Forest Classifier implements learning using models based on a decision tree, and Support Vector Machine (SVM) is a supervised learning technique used to classify data of high dimensionality. With these models in place, we seek to improve the precision and utility of sign language interpretation.

articleTitle: Automated Flower Classification Using ResNet50: A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This research revolves around the application of pretrained ResNet50 for the classification of flower species into five main categories i.e., Rose, Tulip, Sunflower, Daisy, and Dandelion. The study's results in ResNet50 have been achieved to be of great accuracy and robust performance on all classes. With its training and validation over 10 epochs with a batch size of 62, it produced notable results such that the precision, recall, and F1-scores of most categories are greater than 0.87. The confusion matrix indicates good classification accuracy with slight misclassifications between closely related flower types. The best classified classes include Dandelion and Sunflower, with F1-scores of 0.93, while the class that faced the worst case is Rose, which had presented an F1-score of 0.88. Data augmentation and regularization techniques have also been applied to avoid overfitting, because the validation metrics are proof that can be given in this regard. In general, the experiment showed that ResNet50 was efficient in the classification of flowers and may be further improved for precision by limiting more misclassifications between similar species. Consequently, the notion that ResNet50 can be a great helping tool in the automation of flower classification finds its way into botanical research and autonomous agricultural systems.

articleTitle: The Role of Information Technology in Enhancing Organizational Efficiency and Innovation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: In this article potential of Information Technology (IT) in the improvement of organizational performance and innovation is discussed. It uses both quantitative questionnaires and qualitative case investigations to determine how different IT tools enhance operational and organisational innovation solutions. The research findings show that introduced IT solutions, including ERP systems, cloud technologies, and real-time analytics, increase efficiency by improving the effectiveness of processes; by decreasing expenses; and by increasing the speed of making decisions. Furthermore, lately, better technological support from IT technologies, including the Artificial Intelligence (AI) and the Machine Learning (ML), serves as enablers of innovation through new product development and into new markets. However, the study reveals the following various limitations: integration problems, organizational opposition, IT security threats, security threats of personal data, and technological life cycle. To overcome these challenges, change management, strong security solution, and regular IT assessment are the key factors to consider. It further underlines the significance of IT in organisational performance and offers guidelines for future studies to detect the sustainable impact of IT implementation and the contribution of new technologies in sustaining the competitive advantage in the future.

articleTitle: CAREER COMPASS: AI-Based Resume Parser and Automated Job Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: There are many obstacles present in the current job application that candidates have to go through every day, including tedious work of copying the same data to inventories of resumes for every job, ineffective categorization of jobs, and complicated application processes. This paper proposes an ideal resume parser and job categorization solution. Python libraries are used to parse resume with the capability of extracting essential information from different format including PDF and Docx. This extracted data is fed to an intelligent job typification engine which enables job seekers to identify types of jobs suited to their aptitudes and inclinations. Data cleaning is done using regex approaches while vectorization was supported by tf-idf approaches. The evaluation of the system has been done using machine learning algorithms like Decision Tree, Random Forest, AdaBoost, SVM, & Logistic Regression. The performances have been compared on the basis of the training time, precision, accuracy, recall, and F1 score. To improve the efficiency of the system, it is synchronized with LinkedIn to extract real time jobs that are available for the probable job title. The primary goal of this approach is to reduce the time taken to engage in the application process, increase the degree of relevance of matching between applicants and vacancies, and in general, positively impacting the experience of the applicants in the job market.

articleTitle: A Quantitative Analysis of ICT Adoption in Language Education: Factors Influencing Teachers' Attitudes and Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to provide a quantitative review of ICT integration in language teaching and learning with a particular emphasis on secondary school teachers' perceptions and impacts. The study aims at comparing and contrasting the teachers' perception of ICT integrated CLT on the basis of gender, location and type of school. A structured close-ended questionnaire was used and the data was analyzed using descriptive statistics, t-test and one way ANOVA to establish the factors that affect the teachers' attitude and effectiveness in the integration of ICT.

articleTitle: Exploring Novel Horizons and Dimensions in Visual Representation and Interpretation as Transmedia Storytelling Through the Intersection of Photography and AI-Driven Generative Images: A Study
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Information Science and Communications Technologies (ICISCT)
abstract: This research therefore seeks to map out new possibilities and avenues of visuality and visual analysis through a combination of the established photographic medium and generated images drawn from Artificial intelligence in transmedia narrative. As an extension of the study of photorealistic virtual media, this work explores how the incorporation of both AI and established photographic techniques further the potential confines of narrative and intensifies viewers' immersive attention across formats. Following a qualitative approach, the study employs three transmedia cases, visual content analysis, and interviews with creators and recipients. Some research findings show that AI provides a lot of creativity with mesh's rendition of images, which can be generated much more quickly as well as elaborate and inventive designs that alongside the realism of photography. Most people had positive responses-60% of them marked that visuals created by AI impacted positively their comprehension of the narrative. Also, the combined images of real and artificial photography also received high overall and creator and spectator perceptions as the effective means of telling complicated stories. But as pointed out, there were concerns with regards to audience reception and interactions including those that designers were forced to work with a deviation far from standard related icons. This was followed by ethical issues of power and control owning the literature where questions regarding who owns AI-generated work were raised. It is found in this research that the integration of photography and generative art based on artificial intelligence is progressing visualization, creating artistic opportunities while raising profound ethical implications. Subsequent studies should expand on such findings to establish more profound insights into the impact that AI application in various volumes of visual media will have on the future of storytelling and the creative industry as a whole.
